first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and simplifying signup improve early adoption. Verify the most directly relevant onboarding result before acting. Run a small guarded test with segment-level monitoring to ensure fewer steps do not reduce lead qualification, downstream conversion, or qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded simplification of onboarding this week. The verified source shows that shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current completion and activation declines. Monitor qualified signup rate, downstream activation, conversion, retention, and revenue quality to ensure friction reduction does not attract lower-value accounts or weaken qualification. Avoid broad rollout until these downstream measures are confirmed.
